I wish I had the tools to make my own cabinet for home.

Existing used cabinets can be pretty cheap on Craigslist and, with a little TLC (read: paint and patience) can be converted to MAME cabinets without much more than a few very basic tools you probably already have if you have a drill.

And if you want something nice and shiny, a few companies offer pre-CNC'd cabinets you can put together like Ikea furniture, just add your own hardware. I bought a lightly-customized kit from North Coast Custom Arcades that honestly cost too much for the quality I got but it gets the job done and gave me enough insight to probably do a much better job at converting an old cabinet than going in blind. They're not the only one out there but I can vouch that it's not a scam at least.
